body: Resume note for your return; nothing was sent, run or bought. New since the 12:48 handback: the S04 packet (S04-1 to S04-7 take 1 with kitchen blocks; Addendum C applied; two writer's readings named in its header), the P-5 dialogue page, the informant adaptation brief (prepared, not sent; dispatch is Ziggy's), and the review of the notebook round's return (run B v2-only is the return of record; outcomes recorded in the review entry; your fields sent, executed and productionAccepted untouched). What waits on you: (a) the S04 beat grid and the lane calls (lead versus ad-lib for lines 28 to 38; whether S04-6's lead-in words on line 34's tail are on the lead); (b) each S04 block's 11.12 operator steps, in the order of work: the hold's set-only still, the customer's reference round intake (the costume is fixed; the round proposes her face), the S07-3 cockpit still in the bomber and tee (serves S02-6, S04-3, S04-6, S05, S07, S09), the chest-ship design round before S04-4, the overhead-panel and fader stills; (c) the round's two method lessons for ROUND_REQUEST.template.txt (Drive search OFF as a field; the source-count verification: composer chip count plus a listing probe); (d) the informant brief's intake when Ziggy hands it to the swarm; (e) the mailbox registry: the sender id nyquist_claude is not in it. Held: the five opening take-2 blocks until Ziggy's adoption pass on the two Q2 items. Site Nova has the card delta v5 and the panels proposal.
